items.title: LVSA: Training-Free Sparse Attention for Long Video Diffusion
items.summary: Long Video Sparse Attention (LVSA) addresses computational bottlenecks in video diffusion models by introducing a training-free block-sparse attention mechanism that combines structured window patterns with rotating global anchors, reducing compute up to 3.33x while maintaining video quality beyond training horizons.

items.title: Confidence-Adaptive SwiGLU for Mixture-of-Experts
items.summary: Confidence-Aware SwiGLU (κ-SwiGLU) adjusts expert gate sharpness in Mixture-of-Experts models based on token-level routing confidence, improving mean CORE performance with negligible parameter overhead across MoE Transformer models from 8 to 28 layers.

items.title: FineVerify: Scaling Test-Time Compute with Fine-Grained Self-Verification for Agentic Search
items.summary: FineVerify is a self-verification framework for agentic search that decomposes questions into checkable sub-questions, verifies sampled candidates, and selects the best trajectory. With 4 samples it improves GPT-5-mini by 8.2 accuracy points and with 12 samples enables GPT-5-mini to surpass frontier GPT-5 on BrowseComp-Plus.
